Select a compatible checkpoint/model available in your ComfyUI installation.
Use Krea 2 with its matching text encoder and VAE; replace all three SELECT selections.
Three loader warnings are expected until you select those models.
nodes.title: IMPORTANT

widgets_values:
ADVANCED BRUSHES — Hotdog nebula
Five Painted Fields, five advanced brushes, one ridiculous galaxy. Each row is one layer; open its Painted Field to keep painting with the brush that made it.
nodes.title: CONDITIONING LAYERS — EXAMPLE 07

widgets_values: Deep space at night, black velvet void sprinkled with faint distant galaxies, 1970s airbrushed science-fiction paperback cover art.
nodes.title: L1 · Deep space backdrop (prompt)

widgets_values: Each Painted Field stores the brush that painted it. Open any field and that brush is ready, so new strokes match the old ones.
nodes.title: WHAT THIS SHOWS

widgets_values: Open one field at a time, change ONE brush setting, and stamp in an empty spot to compare before and after. Cancel throws the test away.
nodes.title: TRY THIS

widgets_values: Swirling magenta and teal nebula clouds of glowing cosmic gas, soft airbrushed gradients.
nodes.title: L2 · Nebula clouds (prompt)

widgets_values: Click Edit Field… on any Painted Field (or double-click its thumbnail). Done keeps your strokes; Cancel throws them away.
nodes.title: TRY THIS

widgets_values: Brush: Shape Procedural ▸ Noise (Frequency 3, Octaves 3, Hardness 0, Spacing Custom 45%). One diagonal stroke lays down a soft cloud band. Raise Noise Low to 55 for thinner wisps.
nodes.title: TRY THIS

widgets_values: Brilliant four-pointed star glints and sharp white lens flares, airbrushed highlights.
nodes.title: L3 · Star glints (prompt)

widgets_values: Custom Tip: an original four-point sparkle stored inside this workflow, so no image file is needed. Advanced ▸ Brush Shape & Transform ▸ Shape: Custom ▸ Custom Tip ▸ Import Tip PNG… swaps in your own.
nodes.title: WHAT THIS SHOWS

widgets_values: A giant hotdog-shaped constellation traced in glowing gold starlight lines, connected stars.
nodes.title: L4 · Hotdog constellation (prompt)

widgets_values: Hotdog, Count 1: one huge stamp of the line-art template (Hotdog Size 95%, Hotdog Rotation 10°). Its outline becomes a constellation. Click once anywhere for a second one.
nodes.title: WHAT THIS SHOWS

widgets_values: The Hotdog template is line art: each stamp paints the outline of a hotdog, not a filled silhouette. That is why these prompts ask for glowing lines, comets and cut-outs.
nodes.title: IMPORTANT

widgets_values: A shower of flaming hotdog meteors, each outline blazing orange-white like a comet, pulp science-fiction illustration.
nodes.title: L5 · Meteor shower (prompt)

widgets_values: Hotdog, Count 9 in one click: Spread 90% scatters the meteors, Hotdog Rotation 35° plus Rotation Jitter 60 tumbles them, Mirror H flips the set and Hotdog Size 80% sets each meteor's size.
nodes.title: WHAT THIS SHOWS

widgets_values: Brush Library… ▸ Import Preset JSON… ▸ presets/hotdog_meteor_shower.brush.json, select it, then Apply. It matches this row's brush exactly. Opening the workflow does not install it.
nodes.title: TRY THIS

widgets_values: Floating retro diner signboards glowing hot pink with chrome frames, a hotdog silhouette cut out of each board.
nodes.title: L6 · Stencil signboards (prompt)

widgets_values: Invert Template turns each Hotdog stamp inside out: a glowing signboard with the hotdog drawing cut out of it, so deep space shows through the lines.
nodes.title: WHAT THIS SHOWS

widgets_values: Turn Invert Template off and click once in empty space: the same brush now paints two hotdog outlines instead of two signboards.
